verdict.rationale: Qapita's own pages explicitly claim automated, audit-ready financial reporting for ASC 718 and the generation of audit-ready, compliant expense reports using valuation models. That covers the story's core of producing ASC 718 expense reports suitable for auditors. The support is limited to one-line marketing claims, so depth is unverified. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of report contents and export formats (e.g., expense schedules, disclosures, journal entries), and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors accept the output.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors
